usedFor: Woodpecker runs your outreach, and Google Contacts stores the person through “Create Contact” when “Prospect Interested” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Prospect Interested” in Woodpecker, then “Create Contact” in Google Contacts
bestTemplate.why: A prospect marked interested is saved as a contact, so your phone knows who replied.

watchOut: “Email Opened” in Woodpecker fires on every open, so keep “Create Contact” on “Prospect Interested” only.
